items.topic: Thumb CMC arthritis: volar beak/anterior oblique ligament, dorsoradial ligament, and saddle geometry
items.destination_intent: Hand 2026 — 3b4097df-8115-81f8-8afd-e8d1d94d7229; canonical thumb CMC arthritis anatomy section upon explicit logging
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside ligament comparison and arthritis mechanism; preserve both views from exact supplied slide
items.caption_intent: Exact user-supplied anatomy slide. Left palmar view shows anterior oblique/volar beak ligament bridging trapezium to volar-ulnar first metacarpal base; right dorsoradial view shows the stout dorsoradial ligament at the same joint. Classic beak-ligament attenuation model differs from the strongest/primary dorsal restraint distinction. Saddle surfaces are reciprocally concave-convex.
